main_text.p: ex praxi Ecclesiarum Reformatarum patet. Unde in celeberrimâ & optimè constitutâ Ecclesiâ Genevensi, quando pastori successor dandus videtur, Senatus Ecclesiasticus, antequam ad nominationem procedat, petit facultatem à Magistratu: quam si non impetrat, suspendit aut planè omittit nominationem, si impetrat, progreditur, & tunc Magistratui proponit eum, qui ipsi maximè placuisset; qui si approbetur Magistratui, res rata est salvo jure totius Ecclesiæ; si displicet Magistratui, alius eligitur. Et recte atque prudenter observat Wernerus Helmichius olim Ecclesiæ Ultrajectinæ Pastor, indifferens esse ex se, ut vel Magistratus, si alicujus operâ uti velit in ministerio eum proponat Consistorio, vel Consistorium aut Ecclesia si quem cupiat vocari, eum Magistratui proponat; in Tractatu Belgico de vocatione ministrorum. Quę prudētia etiam placet Sibbrando cont. Grot. p. 172. ubi inter alia ait se

page.notes: The head glyph before "IV." is a decorative mark read as "§" with some doubt. The text is set in roman with italic passages as shown. "Grot.p.172" is printed with the number 172 partly obscured, read here as printed. The word "Consistorio" has a faint first letter, read as C. The final word of the page "se" is cut off by the line end and continues on the next page.
